name: Sorbitan isostearate
description: Sorbitan isostearate (CAS 71902-01-7 ) is a non-ionic emulsifier derived from sorbitol and isostearic acid, commercially recognized under the name sorbitan monoisostearate. It functions primarily as a lipophilic emulsifier and co-emulsifier. This versatile chemical stabilizes water-in-oil systems across personal care, food, and industrial formulations. In cosmetics and skin care, it anchors water-in-oil emulsions in creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics. It contributes significantly to skin feel and moisture retention without leaving a heavy residue. Food manufacturers use it to control fat crystallization and improve texture in coatings and confectionery products. In industrial coatings and adhesives, it acts as a dispersant and wetting agent, improving pigment distribution and substrate adhesion. This ensures a more uniform application and better performance in various environments. Textile processing operations apply it as a fiber lubricant and softening agent to improve handle and processing efficiency. This helps in maintaining the quality of the fibers during high-speed manufacturing processes. Sorbitan isostearate is supplied as an amber to pale yellow viscous liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care formulators and industrial buyers. The product is manufactured to meet rigorous industry expectations for purity and performance.
